name: rosettes
title: Rosette Morphology
subtitle: Individual rosette area, shape, and arrangement
description: Segments and measures individual plant rosettes: leaf area, perimeter, circularity, compactness. CIELAB a* threshold robust to LED color casts.
method: CIELAB a* threshold (isolates green channel from background) → size gate → watershed segmentation → measure each rosette.
dataType: overhead rosette images (Arabidopsis, lettuce, seedlings in petri or soil)

parameters.name: astarThreshold
parameters.label: CIELAB a* threshold
parameters.description: Green channel separation. Higher = more selective.

parameters.name: minAreaMm2
parameters.label: Minimum rosette area
parameters.description: Rosettes smaller than this are ignored.
